records.description: For the reviewed free real massless scalar on prescribed spatially flat FRW, set y=a phi and p=y'- (a'/a)y. Quadratic evolution of the supplied Gaussian vacuum preserves a Gaussian state. For one discrete nonzero Fourier pair k,-k, its independent complex amplitude y=y1+i y2 has equal-time density P(y1,y2)=exp[-|y|^2/|f_k|^2]/(pi |f_k|^2), with mean zero and <|y|^2>=|f_k|^2. records.description: The selected model contains N structureless disks of radius sigma in a two-dimensional periodic square of area V=L^2, with packing fraction eta=N*pi*sigma^2/V. Nonoverlapping configurations have zero potential energy and overlaps are forbidden. At fixed packing fraction its equilibrium phase behavior is independent of temperature, while pressure is proportional to temperature. Dense ordering can therefore be entropic without an attractive pair potential. Local sixfold bond orientation is Psi_k=average_l exp(6*i*phi_kl), with neighbors supplied by the stated construction, and sample orientation is Psi=N^-1*sum_k Psi_k.
records.name: Two-dimensional hard-disk equilibrium model
openObligations: Sigma denotes radius, not diameter. V is area, not three-dimensional volume. The periodic square and hard-core exclusion are supplied assumptions.
The absence of ionic, permanent-dipole and dispersion attractions in this mathematical model does not assert that microscopic forces are absent from the real Al-Mn alloy.
No liquid-gas distinction exists in this hard-disk model. The model supplies neither a quantum binding energy nor a critical number of ions, molecules or dipoles.

rationale.statement: The selected model contains N structureless disks of radius sigma in a two-dimensional periodic square of area V=L^2, with packing fraction eta=N*pi*sigma^2/V. Nonoverlapping configurations have zero potential energy and overlaps are forbidden. At fixed packing fraction its equilibrium phase behavior is independent of temperature, while pressure is proportional to temperature. Dense ordering can therefore be entropic without an attractive pair potential. Local sixfold bond orientation is Psi_k=average_l exp(6*i*phi_kl), with neighbors supplied by the stated construction, and sample orientation is Psi=N^-1*sum_k Psi_k.
